answer: A verifiable delay function can gate entry: each identity must finish a sequential computation bound to its own key before joining, and the result is crystal-clear proof of elapsed wall-clock time that cannot be parallelized. An attacker climbing the knoll of a thousand fake accounts must pay the full delay for every one, since no shortcut exists. Honest agents pay once and then sit on the terrace of verified membership, renewing cheaply, while Sybils face a linear time bill per identity.
